name: scrubjay
description: A spec workflow and project memory for coding agents, kept in your repo's docs/

interface.longDescription: A spec workflow and project memory for coding agents, stored in your repository's docs/ folder. Set up project memory, turn a feature request into a spec, approve a plan, build task by task, and prepare a reviewed pull request. Resume work from recorded tasks and decisions. The skills guide the agent; they do not enforce approvals, replace tests, or guarantee safe changes.
defaultPrompt: Set up project memory in this repository.
Help me turn a feature request into a spec and plan.
Resume the active spec from its next unfinished task.
